historical_record.description: The lot at 451 6th Avenue was in public use as a police station.
The City Planning Commission, by a 5-1 vote, approved the Inner Richmond rezoning in part as recommended by staff, a recommendation that included reclassifying this publicly used lot from R-3 to P.
